documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Corrigendum To The Notice Of First Extra Ordinary General Meeting Of Financial Year 2026-27.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management stated that AUM grew 61% year-on-year to INR 8,001 crores and profit after tax reached INR 95 crores, up 59% year-on-year. Credit costs improved to 6.80% of average AUM, and the company remains firmly on track with its full-year guidance parameters including AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability. The loan against property (LAP) portfolio now stands at INR 8,001 crores AUM across 101 branches, and the balance sheet was strengthened by an IPO in May 2026. Onemi Technology Solutions Limited reported its Q1 FY2027 financial and operational results following its NSE and BSE listing in May 2026. Assets Under Management (AUM) crossed ₹8,000 crore, reflecting robust year-on-year growth driven by portfolio expansion.

guidance.claim: The company remains firmly on track with its FY27 guidance across parameters like AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability.
guidance.quote: On the guidance for future, we remain firmly on track for the FY27 guidance we set out on different parameters, be it AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability including ROE and ROA.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its guidance of a 15% reduction in credit cost.
guidance.quote: We firmly hold to our guidance which we gave last quarter, which is 15% reduction in credit cost, and we are tracking well on that.

guidance.claim: Overall growth for the next 12 months is projected to be upwards of 40%.
guidance.quote: Now simple mathematics will tell you that if we have already grown 13% in one quarter, you know, we are only going to overachieve that. So the point I was making on guidance is we remain firmly confident of over-delivering on the number that we had given last quarter of 40%.

guidance.claim: The company expects AUM to grow at north of 40% in FY27 with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection.
guidance.quote: We expect to grow at north of 40% in AUM, with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection, while secured business scale-up is also expected to be strong.

guidance.claim: Management targets gross NPA below 2.25% for FY27.
guidance.quote: On asset quality, we are targeting gross NPA below 2.25%, year-on-year reduction in impairment costs of 10%-15%, and continued improvement in Stage-1 mix.

guidance.claim: Management is targeting a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5%-5% for FY27.
guidance.quote: On profitability, we are targeting a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5%-5%, which entails a return on average equity in the range of 19-21%.

demand_outlook.claim: For the industry, the quality of new customers has softened even as headline delinquencies in personal loans have improved.
demand_outlook.quote: For the industry, the quality of new customers has softened even as headline delinquencies in personal loans have improved - both are true at once.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that India's long-term structural credit opportunity remains promising due to economic growth and credit underpenetration.
demand_outlook.quote: As we look ahead to FY27, we remain optimistic about India's long-term structural credit opportunity. Many reasons for that, not only economic growth that the country will see, but also the huge degree of credit under penetration which exists, while at the same time being realistic and cautious about near-term conditions.

capex_expansion.claim: The Loan Against Property (LAP) business has 101 branches across eight states.
capex_expansion.quote: LAP business which we started two years back, the AUM stands at INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states, about 7.7% of the total AUM.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add at least 80 more branches for the LAP business by the end of the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We plan to have at least 80 more branches by end of this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Credit cost was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Credit cost was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Opex as a proportion of AUM has come down from 19.9% to 18.0%.
margins_costs.quote: You must have seen the operating leverage some evidence of that, 19.9% cost which was opex as a proportion of AUM has already come down to 18.0% percent.

margins_costs.claim: Impairment cost as a percentage of average AUM fell from 9.7% in FY25 to 8.2% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: But the payoff is visible - our impairment cost as a percentage of average AUM has fallen from 9.7% in FY25 to 8.2% in FY26 and in Q4 alone, it stood at 7%.

orders_capacity.claim: Registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million, and total customers served reached 12.25 million.
orders_capacity.quote: The registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million. We have now served 12.25 million customers, an increase of 26% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: On-book AUM stood at INR 3,716 crores and off-book AUM at INR 4,284 crores, representing a 46:54 split.
orders_capacity.quote: On-book AUM of INR 3,716 crores and off-book AUM of INR 4,284 crores, a 46:54 split, supported by more than 45 lending partners.

orders_capacity.claim: Loan Against Property (LAP) AUM stands at nearly ₹ 518 crore across 98 branches in 8 states.
orders_capacity.quote: LAP AUM stands at nearly ₹ 518 crore, across 98 branches in 8 states, contributing 7.3% of total AUM.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, supported by retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, nearly four times its level in March 2023, built on retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital adequacy in the NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% last quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital adequacy in our NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately ₹ 630 crore of the primary issue has already been infused as fresh equity into the NBFC subsidiary, Si Creva Capital.
capital_allocation.quote: 75% of the primary issue, approximately ₹ 630 crore have been already infused as fresh equity into our NBFC subsidiary, which is Si Creva Capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Bureau data for the industry shows stress building up in small ticket loans and borrowers carrying debt across multiple lenders.
risks_headwinds.quote: The bureau data for the industry now shows a clear divergence beneath a calm surface. Talking about industry, headline asset quality looks benign, yet beneath the surface, stress is building, concentrated in a few places, particularly in the small ticket loans or instances of borrowers carrying debt across several lenders at once, and households taking new lines only to service old ones.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management paused lending across approximately 450 pin codes last quarter, and has since reopened about 40% of them.
risks_headwinds.quote: Just to give you an instance, last quarter, out of caution, we paused lending across roughly 450 pin codes based on what our early warning system had flagged. We have re-examined those pin codes since. The signals have turned modestly positive, and we have reopened approximately 40% of these pin codes already.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted global factors such as higher oil prices, elevated rates, geopolitical disruptions, and currency volatility as factors weighing on India.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global environment has been one of the defining themes of the recent past - higher oil prices, elevated rates, geopolitical disruptions, currency volatility, these are all the factors weighing on India too.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects a cost of borrowing reduction of a minimum of 100 basis points over the next three quarters.
management_commitments.quote: Krishnan has already mentioned so I don't want to reiterate it, but just the point which Krishnan said, over the next three quarter, we will see a cost of fund of minimum 100 basis point improvement if not higher.

management_commitments.claim: The loan against property (LAP) business is expected to achieve breakeven around Q3 of this year.
management_commitments.quote: Because you can’t build a business without having the initial drag. But after having achieved breakeven. Somewhere around Q3 of this year, it will only be delivering the desired ROE for which we started the business.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects funding costs to ease meaningfully over the coming quarters following the A- credit rating in February 2026.
management_commitments.quote: With our recent A- credit rating in February 2026, we expect funding costs to ease meaningfully over the coming quarters.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to grow AUM at north of 40% with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to grow at north of 40% in AUM, with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection, while secured business scale-up is also expected to be strong.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting gross NPA below 2.25% and a year-on-year reduction in impairment costs of 10%-15% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On asset quality, we are targeting gross NPA below 2.25%, year-on-year reduction in impairment costs of 10%-15%, and continued improvement in Stage-1 mix.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5%-5% and return on average equity of 19%-21% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: On profitability, we are targeting a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5%-5%, which entails a return on average equity in the range of 19-21%.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to have at least 80 more branches for the LAP business by the end of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We plan to have at least 80 more branches by end of this financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
